question: Who won the 2025 Wimbledon singles titles?
text:
- **Men’s singles:** Jannik Sinner defeated Carlos Alcaraz 4–6, 6–4, 6–4, 6–4. ([assets.wimbledon.com](https://assets.wimbledon.com/archive/draws/pdfs/draws/2025_MS_A4.pdf?utm_source=openai))
- **Women’s singles:** Iga Świątek defeated Amanda Anisimova 6–0, 6–0. ([wimbledon.com](https://www.wimbledon.com/en_GB/scores/draws/2025_LS_draw.pdf?utm_source=openai))
